_source: docs/DECODER-OS.md — §4 The Decode Engine (signature flow) + §6 Format & Platform OS
_law: One move (THE DECODE), one clock (your rates), N shows. Every post is the same six beats in the same order — only the container stretches.

decode_6_beats.job: break the pattern — rename a familiar body/behaviour as a system
decode_6_beats.on_screen: full-bleed word card, no fitness clichés
decode_6_beats.fails_if: it's a claim, not a renaming

decode_6_beats.job: pay off the reframe with the actual anatomy, named precisely
decode_6_beats.on_screen: real structure or clean diagram (écorché render)
decode_6_beats.fails_if: it stays poetic and never lands on real tissue

decode_6_beats.job: exactly ONE hard number, sourced on screen — this is also the Clock
decode_6_beats.on_screen: number huge + citation in Space Mono lower-third
decode_6_beats.fails_if: two numbers, or a number with no source

decode_6_beats.job: the 'oh — I had this wrong' jolt that drives shares
decode_6_beats.on_screen: red strike-through on the false belief (one only)
decode_6_beats.fails_if: it kills a strawman nobody believes

decode_6_beats.job: convert biology into ONE concrete instruction — the save-bait
decode_6_beats.fails_if: it explains but never tells them what to do Monday

decode_6_beats.job: route to the free Body-Scan → programs. One CTA only
decode_6_beats.fails_if: two CTAs compete, or it's generic ('follow for more')

screenshot_proof_rule: Beat 1 may be poetic. Beats 2–3 must be literal, anatomical and cited. Poetry never outruns physiology.
sign_off: Read your clock. Then train it.

the_one_clock.principle: Every system in the body keeps time; everything that matters is a rate. The page makes the viewer fluent in their own rates — the Body-Scan is where they get their numbers.

clock_hud.spec: Space Mono, gold #D4A148 on graphite #101115, fixed top-right, every post

the_one_clock.grid_effect: scroll the profile and you see a wall of ticking numbers — instant recognition before a word is read
the_one_clock.funnel_reframe: Body-Scan = 'sync your clock — get your baseline rates'
the_one_clock.fbm_wiring: in the film engine this is the living widget (hud_gauge / ring / trace) + the bed's phase-locked ticks — the same number, animated in both
